speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is a man at the street door. A neighbour's journeyman. He has an account of the morning, and he offers it as if it were a kindness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell him I am at my work.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And if he says he will wait?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will not wait. Say the sentence, and shut the door.
